# Open choices: web-front-end

`aidd-team:web-front-end` leaves these decisions to the team. aidd's default holds until a `standards` entry fills one. `aidd standard list` names the library standards for each choice, and `aidd standard add` adopts one.

| Choice | Question | aidd's default | Options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `web-framework` | Which framework renders the web front end? | The framework the app already uses. For a new app, one that renders on the server and meets the browser support target. | Next.js, React Router, SvelteKit, Nuxt, Astro, Angular, TanStack Router, TanStack Start |
| `styling` | Which tool turns the design tokens into the styles of the components? | Tailwind CSS, with a theme generated from the design tokens and the default palette removed, so a class can name only a token. | Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, Plain CSS on the token custom properties, vanilla-extract |
| `component-library` | Which library gives the front end its accessible components? | The components `DESIGN.md` lists. Else, on a React stack, shadcn/ui items kept as source on Base UI or Radix primitives; on another stack, its accessible headless library. | shadcn/ui, React Aria Components, Angular CDK, Reka UI |
| `data-fetching` | Which library holds the server data a client screen reads? | TanStack Query, one query cache per app with a staleness set for each query. A page the server renders reads its first data on the server. | TanStack Query, SWR, RTK Query, Apollo Client, The framework's own data loaders |
| `e2e-test` | Which runner drives a real browser for end-to-end tests? | Playwright (`@playwright/test`), which the browser checks of `aidd-team:accessible-ui` and `aidd-team:product-defaults` also run. | Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO |
| `component-test` | Which library tests a component the way a person uses it? | Testing Library for the web framework in use, run by the project's test runner. | Testing Library, Vitest browser mode, Cypress component testing, Storybook interaction tests |
